inputs: Only the root-authorized staged publication manifest and its selected staged files; no source re-discovery, source absolute paths, remote lookups, or V112 access.
credential_output: Only logical path, rule name, and match count. Never emit matched text, line content, snippets, credentials, or contextual exception text. Pattern matches are possible credentials, not a claim of active credential validation.
storage_size: Every selected physical stored file must be strictly smaller than 100 MiB (104857600 bytes). Chunked logical texts may exceed that size after reconstruction; each published stored chunk must remain below it.
text_scope: Selected textual logical paths are scanned after raw/gzip/parts decoding. Compressed parts are streamed, with overlapping scan windows to retain cross-boundary matches. Arrays, images, weights, and datasets are not decoded.
portable_markdown: Only explicitly named portable paths or portable-prefix Markdown files are checked for relative links/images. Original archived text and plain absolute provenance strings are not portability errors. Code examples are excluded. External web/mail links and fragment-only references are not fetched. Local relative targets must exist inside the publication root; absolute local link targets in portable docs are reported as nonportable.
path_safety: Check every selected logical/stored name for V112 before any resolve/stat/open. A forbidden path is reported and never touched. No directory scanning or traversal outside the staged publication root.
